title: The area under x√(1 − x²)
caption: With u = 1 − x² the integral becomes ½∫₀¹ u^½ du = ⅓. The graph shows the same area directly: the region under y = x√(1 − x²) from 0 to 1 is exactly 1/3.
alt: The curve y = x√(1 − x²) rising from the origin to a peak of 0.5 near x = 0.71 and returning to zero at x = 1, with the area under it shaded.
description: u = 1 − x² gives du = −2x dx, so x dx = −½ du.
The integral becomes ½∫₀¹ u^½ du = ½ × ⅔ = ⅓.
The shaded area under the original curve is 1/3.
